messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Volta Executive Team,

Your executive-search focus on energy, decarbonisation and industrial leadership aligns closely with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy transition, responsible development and institutional engagement intersect. I am internationally mobile and open to senior cross-border appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
